name: Guarded Residual Application Canary

B_observe_only_pager.pager_activity: layer0 ffn_up/ffn_down/attn_out/ffn_gate all non-null, layers 1-23 not_in_manifest

C_guarded_application_canary.pager_activity: shadow decode of layer0/attn_out .trit, app_attempts=1, app_success=1
C_guarded_application_canary.note: shadow decode succeeded; decoded bytes not fed into model compute

key_findings.shadow_decode_works: prt_trit_decoder::decode_bytes() successfully decoded .trit header + payload for layer0/attn_out
key_findings.observe_only_preserved: Without --prt-sidecar-apply flag, app_attempts=0 and no decode attempted
key_findings.target_filter_works: Only the exact (layer=0, family=attn_out) pair triggers shadow decode; other families/layers skip
key_findings.not_in_manifest_guard: layers 1-23 instantly return null reason=not_in_manifest with no activation attempt
key_findings.budget_zero_rejects: budget=0 causes all 4 family activations to be rejected at layer0 (budget_rejects=4)
key_findings.no_output_corruption: shadow decode did not corrupt model output; Hello generated correctly
key_findings.raw_bytes_not_cast: No raw .trit bytes cast to float*; proper decode_path used

new_functions: prt_shadow_apply(view_ptr, layer, family) - decodes .trit via decode_bytes(), records counters, does NOT feed into model

risks_and_limitations: Shadow decode only — actual residual injection into model compute not yet tested
Single family/layer target only; multi-target not implemented
No checksum validation of decoded floats before deallocation
Exit 0 but no token generated in observe-only mode — timing of output vs pager hook timing
qwen2.5:0.5b only — not tested on larger models
next_phase: Phase 28BR - True Residual Injection (if shadow decode verified clean)
